sources.title: kaitchup/Qwen3.5-2B-autoround-W4A16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B quantized with AutoRound to W4A16 (INT). The model is compatible with vLLM (tested: v0.16.1rc1). Tested with an H200. Currently under evaluation. Developed by: The Kaitchup Instructions

sources.title: j3st3r666/Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An int4 weight-only (W4A16) quantization of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, made with Intel AutoRound and packaged in compressed-tensors for vLLM. The weights are int4 and the activations stay BF16, so it runs on any Ampere-or-newer NVIDIA GPU through the Marlin int4 kernel — no Blackwell needed.

sources.title: 2026-08-17-autoround-w4a16-v100.md - GitHub
sources.snippet: Context The 35B A3B MoE model (Qwen3.6 hybrid: GDR linear attention + full attention + 256 experts) produced degenerate output on the previous W4A16-fixed checkpoint (GPTQ fused-expert corruption, llm-compressor #2939). Switched to the AutoRound W4A16 checkpoint, which uses a different quantization method and should avoid the fused-expert bug.
